scope: UFF prepared energy and analytic-gradient dispatch/soundness probe
geometry: two-atom single-bond probe at [0,0,0] and [1.8,0.2,0.1] Angstrom
additional_fixture: four-carbon chain with a genuine 1-4 prepared vdW pair, checked against central differences
gradient_check: central difference delta 1e-5 Angstrom; maximum absolute error below 2e-3 kcal/mol/Angstrom for every probed coordinate
boundary: This verifies local finite energy and gradient consistency for the 18 public element dispatch probes and all 45 declared UffType variants; it does not establish independent UFF parameter parity, coordination-geometry validity, convergence, or stereo correctness.
